nameEn: Retail sale via stalls and markets of food, beverages and tobacco products
description: This class includes the retail sale of food, beverages and tobacco via market stalls and similar selling points.
includes: retail sale of food via outdoor market stalls
retail sale of beverages via market stalls
retail sale of tobacco products via market stalls
operation of food markets and bazaars
excludes: retail sale of food in stores, see 4711, 4721
